posts.copy: Chat is the surface. Continuity is the feature. An authorized channel message can dispatch a bound Replicant, resume its provider session, and persist the final reply in your self-hosted workspace. MIT: https://github.com/replicantos/replicantos
posts.alt: Playwright capture of the deterministic offline synthetic ReplicantOS demo, not a live or private workspace. A channel conversation, workspace roster, and persisted Replicant replies are visible.

posts.copy: One control plane, four adapters: Codex and the optional Claude Agent SDK are stable; OpenCode and Grok Build are beta. Provider runtimes and credentials stay on your host. MIT: https://github.com/replicantos/replicantos
posts.alt: Playwright capture of the deterministic offline synthetic ReplicantOS demo, not live diagnostics. Four unchecked adapter cards show Codex, Claude Agent SDK, OpenCode, and Grok Build.

posts.copy: Agents shouldn't disappear behind a spinner. Each dispatched run records durable state, normalized events, available usage, and final output. Providers can request approval; authorized users can request cancellation. https://github.com/replicantos/replicantos
posts.alt: Playwright capture of the deterministic offline synthetic ReplicantOS demo, not a live or private run. The Runs view shows synthetic run history, a selected run with usage and output, persisted event rows, and a pending approval card.

posts.copy: Recurring agent work should be inspectable. ReplicantOS stores timezone-aware schedules, assigned Replicants, last and next run times, plus an audited Run Now action. https://github.com/replicantos/replicantos
posts.alt: Playwright capture of the deterministic offline synthetic ReplicantOS demo, not live operational data. Three schedules show cron timing, assigned Replicants, last and next runs, and Run Now controls.

posts.copy: The moment you add a second human, permissions stop being optional. ReplicantOS enforces owner, admin, and member ceilings plus scoped allow and deny grants on the server. https://github.com/replicantos/replicantos
posts.alt: Playwright capture of the deterministic offline synthetic ReplicantOS demo, not live account data. Owner and member rows show role ceilings and scoped channel, Replicant, and task access.

posts.copy: A bot saying “done” isn't a task system. ReplicantOS persists status, priority, notes, and optional Replicant assignment; the v0.1 board keeps status, priority, and assignee visible. https://github.com/replicantos/replicantos
posts.alt: Playwright capture of the deterministic offline synthetic ReplicantOS demo, not live task data. Four task columns show visible priorities and optional Replicant assignment.

posts.copy: Chat is a terrible document archive. ReplicantOS indexes explicitly approved Markdown and text files, verifies content hashes, and serves a readable preview from a configured safe root. https://github.com/replicantos/replicantos
posts.alt: Playwright capture of the deterministic offline synthetic ReplicantOS demo, not live document data. Approved Markdown and text entries appear beside a readable document preview.

posts.copy: Approved workspace files shouldn't be opaque. ReplicantOS safely browses and edits UTF-8 text inside configured roots, with realpath containment and symlink-escape rejection. https://github.com/replicantos/replicantos
posts.alt: Playwright capture of the deterministic offline synthetic ReplicantOS demo, not live host data. An approved workspace tree appears beside a UTF-8 Markdown source editor.

posts.copy: Local-first shouldn't mean opaque. ReplicantOS v0.1 uses SQLite and includes an admin-only viewer with allowlisted tables, masked columns, bounded pages—and no arbitrary SQL. https://github.com/replicantos/replicantos
posts.alt: Playwright capture of the deterministic offline synthetic ReplicantOS demo, not live records. An allowlisted table shows bounded rows while protected columns and sensitive tables remain unavailable.

posts.copy: Self-hosted can still fit in your pocket. ReplicantOS is a responsive, installable PWA for channels, tasks, schedules, runs, files, the Library, database viewer, and settings. https://github.com/replicantos/replicantos
posts.alt: Playwright capture of the deterministic offline synthetic ReplicantOS demo at a narrow viewport, not a live workspace. Mobile navigation exposes the implemented product areas.
